source_file: Summarize vars univariately/Summarize all vars in a table univariately.sas
notes: The %tabulate macro (byte-identical to source) turns a PROC MEANS/SUMMARY WAYS-1 output into a long-format univariate frequency table via open()/varname()/attrn() introspection plus a DATA step SELECT/WHEN dispatch keyed on _TYPE_. Substituted the external AAC.tx_offbal_final_202105_20201012 UNC-path table with a small mock WORK.claims_sample (5 rows, region/status); used CLASS region status (explicit list) instead of the source's CLASS _all_, since Jenner does not yet expand _ALL_ inside a PROC MEANS CLASS statement (filed separately) -- CLASS with an explicit variable list is equally documented PROC MEANS syntax and is exactly the form the source's own sibling file (Reminders/Tabulate.sas) demonstrates for this same macro.
